Reporting to the Vice President / Chief Nursing Officer, The Divisional Director of Neuropsychiatry is responsible for the management of Neuropsychiatry Nursing services at UCI Health - Orange. The Director provides services to meet physician and HealthSystem objectives in the following areas: a) patient care, teaching and research, b) clinical resource management, and c) developing and administering an operating budget for capital, and programs. Maintains responsibility for the direction, administration, quality, coordination, and evaluation of patient care activities, and support services are efficiently performed to support patient care in each of the Cost Centers in the Division. Maintains direct supervision of division management and indirect supervision of staff FTEs 7days a week, 24 hours a day. Serves as the primary point of contact for inpatient behavioral health operations and collaborates closely with facility and health system leaders to align clinical operations with organizational goals and standards.
